tiers.name: restricted
tiers.label: Restricted
tiers.purpose: Secrets and high-impact business data with strong legal or financial exposure.
examples: API tokens
agent/service-account credentials and one-time issued machine tokens
password hashes and auth signing keys
temporary default test credentials (for example admin/123456)
database credentials
HSCIQ API keys
backend environment overrides containing real secrets
signed and system-generated legal/financial contract artifacts
supplier bank account names, account numbers, branches, and bank routing codes
company bank statements, transaction identifiers, account balances, and even masked account identifiers when combined with transaction rows
carrier packing-list originals and persistent packing-list review records

storage: Secrets only in .env or secret manager
Browser access tokens remain tab-scoped in sessionStorage; missing-token login messaging never grants access or exposes token values
System-configured API keys are write-only; encrypted storage is permitted but complete values must never be returned or rendered
Restricted business records only in the application database or protected contract-evidence storage
Least privilege file mode (<=600 for backend .env)
Contract artifact and SQLite backup directories use 0700 and files use 0600
Legacy procurement attachment handlers reuse fileService permission enforcement and resolve downloads against UPLOAD_DIR
Carrier packing-list raw extracted text is not persisted; structured check records retain their original file reference
HTTP request logs retain route, timing, and request shape only; request/query values, AI prompts, tool schemas, and user messages are excluded
transfer: Do not paste into tickets/chat unless redacted
controls.retention: Rotate on role change; remove stale values within 24h of lifecycle end

tiers.name: confidential
tiers.label: Confidential
tiers.purpose: Business-sensitive internal data that is not publicly shareable.
examples: purchase contract and sales records
historical procurement templates and their store/purchase details
supplier pricing and margins
financial summary reports, cash-flow statements, account balances, general-ledger entries, payroll, social-security, and tax-return structured rows
inventory and shipment operational history

storage: Use role-based filtering at API response layer
Procurement-template reads require authentication at backend/src/routes/procurementTemplate.js before historical data is loaded
Monthly financial source files are parsed in memory; persist structured rows plus filename, size, and SHA-256 only
Financial evidence workbooks are never archived; sensitive personal identifiers are redacted before persistence and row-level reads require ADMIN or FINANCE
transfer: Mask identifiers in non-prod shared environments
controls.retention: Keep no longer than product/legal requirement; archive with access audit

tiers.name: internal
tiers.label: Internal
tiers.purpose: General internal information for team coordination and operation.
examples: planning docs
test fixtures
build scripts
readme and API contract docs
ByteRover engineering memory that excludes secrets and business-sensitive data

controls.retention: Keep in repository history as needed and clean when obsolete
